home.aboutTitle: My story, and what makes the work unique
home.companyHtml: IYC Studio, which stands for Improve Yourself Constantly, is much more than a name. It is a philosophy. It reflects my ongoing drive to improve, both technically and artistically. Based in Bordeaux, the studio is the result of a path rich in experience, adaptability and passion.
home.companyHtml2: Through IYC Studio, I aim to go beyond what you expect by bringing out your personality and capturing unique moments. Each project is a chance to lift your memories and make images that stay with you.
home.welcomeHtml: Welcome to IYC Studio, where every photo is made to tell a story: yours. I love capturing true emotion and genuine moments, and I believe each image should reflect the essence of its subject. Drawn to detail, natural light and the uniqueness of every person, I put all of my experience into your photo project.
home.versatileText: Every session is tailored to you, mixing creativity, closeness and an artistic touch so that precious moments become lasting memories. My style, between authenticity and originality, makes photographs that look like no one else's.

home.reviewsText: See what clients say about the photographs.

He takes an interest in you, and he takes the time to talk about your outfits, the kinds of places you like, and the result you want. A very professional photographer who knows his craft. I recommend him without hesitation.

contact.faqIntro: Answers to the questions clients ask most
contact.a1Html:
A shoot happens in four steps:

  1. We talk. The need, the place, the outfit, and the result you want to keep.
  2. The session. I guide you, without rushing, toward natural photos.
  3. Your gallery. You receive private access to see the photos and choose the ones included in the package.
  4. Delivery. I retouch your selection and send it in high resolution.
contact.q2: How long until the retouched photos are delivered?
contact.a2Html:
The usual time is 7 to 10 working days after the session. That time covers the edit, the retouching and putting the gallery online.

For delivery within 24 hours, the express option is €50.
contact.q3: What are the usage rights for the photos?
contact.a3Html:
For a portrait, personal use is included: social media, a CV, a personal website and prints for you.

Commercial use, for a company or a campaign, is set out in the quote. The photos remain my property: they cannot be resold or altered without agreement.
contact.q4: What are the best places for a photo session in Bordeaux?
contact.a4Html:
Bordeaux has beautiful settings for photographs. Here is what I recommend:

For urban professional portraits:

  • Place de la Bourse - Water mirror, classical architecture
  • Rue Sainte-Catherine - A lively urban atmosphere
  • Pont de Pierre - Views over the Garonne, sunsets
  • Grand Théâtre - Elegance and neoclassical architecture

For natural lifestyle portraits:

  • Jardin Public - Greenery, soft natural light
  • Quays of Bordeaux - Along the Garonne, a relaxed mood
  • Chartrons district - Authentic lanes, colored walls
  • Parc Bordelais - Nature, quiet, a variety of settings

I can also suggest places that fit your style and the season. Tell me what you prefer.
contact.q5: What happens if the weather is bad?
contact.a5Html:
The weather can be unpredictable, and there are several ways through it:

  • Free reschedule: if the conditions are truly poor, we can move the session at no extra cost
  • Covered places: Bordeaux has many beautiful covered spaces (passages, arcades, covered markets)
  • Indoor shoot: we can switch to an indoor shoot with natural light
  • Light rain: sometimes a fine rain creates a unique, artistic mood

I watch the forecast in the days before your session and contact you if a change is needed.
contact.q6: Can I order extra photos after the session?
contact.a6Html:
Yes. One retouched photo beyond the package is €15.

You choose it in your private gallery, tell me which one, and I send it once it is retouched.
